protocol.scope: Opt-in finite-horizon sampled-PWM allocation using explicit motor reachability; no PID, body dynamics, CAD/CG/inertia requirement or hardware integration
protocol.priority_contract: Among accepted sampled PWM candidates, minimize published high3 normalized squared residual first; then yaw among candidates within the global high minimum plus tolerance; then movement within both global tolerance bands. This is not a continuous-PWM optimum or a yaw optimum over the entire primary-tolerance motor-effort sublevel set.

audit_policy.description: Frozen audit times before evaluation: independently enumerate all 27 faces for every accepted candidate at these rows. Full-time traces retain summary only; candidate arrays are not archived per tick.

protocol.metrics_policy: Score all actual rows and separately the declared transition windows. Dynamic priority is a predicted horizon guarantee over accepted samples; actual transient performance under delay/mismatch/faults is measured without presuming improvement. Missing state/authority yields explicit static fallback, never fabricated zero RPM.
protocol.provenance: All maps, coefficients, predictor/motor dynamics and corrected-count mappings are synthetic placeholders inherited from a pinned base protocol. The original e7608a372 evidence remains reproducible from that commit; opt-in callback use is separately versioned. No real-aircraft fit or mechanical-angle calibration.
